items.name: clio-skills
items.title: Skills
items.description: Skills for primary scientific workflows, without MCP servers.
items.summary: Skills for primary scientific workflows, without MCP servers.

items.name: bibliography
items.title: Bibliography
items.description: Use when assembling verified citations, BibTeX records or a research reading list. Triggers on "BibTeX", "cite these papers", "reference list". Not for broad topic discovery; use research-survey.
items.summary: Assemble verified citations, BibTeX records and research reading lists.

items.name: chart-select
items.title: Chart Selection
items.description: Use when choosing a chart, axes, bins or color scale for scientific data. Triggers on "which chart", "log scale", "color map". Calls no tools. Not for rendering a chart; use results-summary.
items.summary: Choose a chart type, axes, bins and color scale that suit scientific data.

items.name: chimod-dev
items.title: Developing a CLIO Core module (ChiMod)
items.description: Use when writing your own CLIO Core runtime module (ChiMod) outside the clio-core repo: install with headers, clio_mod.yaml, tasks, runtime, client, codegen, CMake, loading, testing, or a CTE interposer layer. Triggers on "new chimod", "custom module", "add a method", "clio_mod.yaml", "clio-run refresh", "CreateParams", "CLIO_REPO_PATH", "CoreInterposer". Not for configuring shipped modules; use storage-compose. Not for GPU paged-vector kernels; use gpu-vector.
items.summary: Build or extend a CLIO Core runtime module: tasks, runtime, client, codegen, CMake and tests.

items.name: clio-bdev
items.title: clio-bdev: block devices and the safe_bdev array
items.description: Use when configuring CLIO Core block devices: a clio_bdev pool (ram, file, hbm, pinned, noop, s3, gcs, daos), a CTE storage tier entry, capacity, persistence_level, alloc_log and --fresh, or a clio_safe_bdev erasure-coded array (members, parity, max_failures, rebuild). Triggers on "bdev_type", "capacity_limit", "alloc_log", "persistence_level", "safe_bdev", "parity disk", "S3 tier". Not for designing the whole chain (use storage-compose) or CTE core keys (use clio-cte-core).
items.summary: Configure CLIO block devices and CTE tiers, allocator durability and the erasure-coded safe_bdev array.

items.name: clio-cae
items.title: Context Assimilation Engine (`clio_cae_core`, `clio_cae_summarizer`)
items.description: Use when importing external data into CLIO Core with the Context Assimilation Engine: writing OMNI files, running clio-cae, calling ParseOmni or clio_cee context_bundle from Python/C++, choosing sources (file, HDF5, HTTP, S3, GCS, Globus), allowed_roots, or composing the LLM summarizer (401.0). Triggers on "OMNI file", "clio-cae", "assimilate", "ParseOmni", "context_bundle", "label_matches", "summarizer". Not for searching imported data (use clio-indexer) or chain ordering (use storage-compose).
items.summary: Import files, HDF5 datasets and cloud objects into CLIO with OMNI files and clio-cae, plus the LLM summarizer.

items.name: clio-compressor
items.title: clio-compressor: transparent blob compression
items.description: Use when enabling, configuring or debugging clio_cte_compressor (pool 562.0): building with CLIO_CTE_ENABLE_COMPRESS or Spack +compress, default_compress and presets, static vs dynamic (model-chosen) codecs, GPU codecs, chain placement, and stored vs logical size. Triggers on "compress my blobs", "default_compress", "zstd", "lz4", "kCompressDynamic", "562.0", "compression ratio". Not for choosing or ordering the whole chain; use storage-compose. Not for the blob API itself; use clio-cte-core.
items.summary: Compress CTE blobs transparently: build it, pick codecs, set defaults and place it in the chain.

items.name: clio-cte-caches
items.title: CTE cache modules
items.description: Use when choosing, composing, tuning or debugging a CLIO Core CTE cache module: write-back (567.0), write-thru, the shared-memory cache (568.0) or the node-copy cache (563.0). Covers keys, chain order, ack and fsync semantics, staleness and loss per failure. Triggers on "write-back cache", "flush_period_ms", "fsync is slow", "lost writes after crash", "md_only", "invalidate_on_flush", "stale size on another node". Not for the core or chain design; use clio-cte-core or storage-compose.
items.summary: Choose and tune the CTE write-back, write-thru, shared-memory and node-copy caches, and what each loses on failure.

items.name: clio-cte-core
items.title: CTE core (`clio_cte_core`)
items.description: Use when configuring, calling or debugging the Context Transfer Engine core (clio_cte_core): the persistent core at 512.0, the volatile core at 540.0, tiers, scores, the metadata WAL and the C++/Python blob API (Tag, PutBlob, GetBlob, TagQuery, SyncTag) every chain speaks. Triggers on "clio_cte_core", "512.0", "540.0", "PutBlob rc=11", "metadata_log_path", "clio_cte_core_ext", "persistence_level". Not for choosing or ordering the chain; use storage-compose. Not for bdev keys; use clio-bdev.
items.summary: Configure and call the CTE core: tiers, scores, the metadata log and the C++ and Python blob API.

items.name: clio-fs
items.title: clio-fs: files over the Context Transfer Engine
items.description: Use when mounting, configuring or debugging the CLIO Core POSIX file layer: the filesystem ChiMod (560.0), the stream ChiMod (565.0), the clio_cte_fuse mount on Linux/Windows/macOS, the checkpoint fault handler (566.0), and the LD_PRELOAD/MPI-IO/HDF5/ADIOS2 adapters. Triggers on "clio_cte_fuse", "mount CLIO", "metadata_log_path", "CLIO_FUSE_", "fsync EIO", "case_insensitive", "stream pool". Not for chain design or blob APIs; use storage-compose or clio-cte-core.
items.summary: Mount CLIO as a POSIX filesystem and configure its filesystem and stream modules, fsync guarantees and adapters.

items.name: clio-indexer
items.title: Indexer: keyword search over blob contents (`clio_cte_indexer`)
items.description: Use when configuring, scoping, debugging or calling the CLIO Core keyword search index (clio_cte_indexer, pool 564.0): BM25 SemanticSearch over blob contents from Python (clio_cte_core_ext, or clio_cee context_query with a prompt) or C++, index persistence, memory growth, ReindexScan. Triggers on "SemanticSearch", "search my files", "context_query prompt", "564.0", "index_log_path", "indexer OOM". Not for ingesting data (use clio-cae) or ordering the chain (use storage-compose).
items.summary: Search CTE blob contents with the BM25 indexer: scope it, persist it, bound its memory and query it from Python.

items.name: clio-replication
items.title: clio-replication: durable copies and node failover
items.description: Use when configuring, reasoning about or testing clio_cte_replication (pool 561.0): replication_factor and remote copies on successor nodes, failover_to_successor, hand-back after a node returns, handoff_log_path, on-node replicas, and node or disk loss. Triggers on "replication_factor", "remote_copies", "failover_to_successor", "hand-back", "survive a node", "561.0". Not for choosing or ordering the whole chain; use storage-compose. Not for core tiers or WAL; use clio-cte-core.
items.summary: Keep copies of CTE data on successor nodes, with failover and hand-back, and know what survives node loss.

items.name: clio-runtime-config
items.title: Running and configuring the Context Runtime
items.description: Use when installing, starting, configuring or troubleshooting the CLIO Core Context Runtime itself: where clio.yaml comes from, networking/runtime/swim/viz keys, compose entry basics, CLIO_* environment variables, clio-run start/stop/status/compose, --fresh, multi-node hostfiles, Docker, client connection. Triggers on "clio-run start", "~/.clio/clio.yaml", "CLIO_SERVER_CONF", "hostfile", "port 9413", "runtime not running". Not for designing a storage chain; use storage-compose.
items.summary: Run and configure the CLIO Context Runtime: config file, environment variables, the clio-run CLI, multi-node and Docker.

items.name: cluster-run
items.title: Cluster Run
items.description: Use when resolving Spack software, configuring a JARVIS pipeline and following its execution. Triggers on "run this on the cluster", "JARVIS pipeline", "install and run". Not for handwritten batch scripts; use slurm-script.
items.summary: Resolve software with Spack, configure a JARVIS pipeline and follow its execution.

items.name: coordinate-systems
items.title: Coordinate Systems
items.description: Use when interpreting axis order, projections, distance units or vertical datums. Triggers on "lat lon", "CRS", "UTM", "map offset". Calls no tools. Not for executing map operations; use geospatial-map.
items.summary: Interpret axis order, map projections, distance units and vertical datums correctly.

items.name: data-clean
items.title: Data Cleaning
items.description: Use when profiling missing values, duplicates, outliers and validation rules before analysis. Triggers on "clean this data", "missing values", "validate this CSV". Not for plotting; use results-summary.
items.summary: Profile missing values, duplicates and outliers, and set validation rules before analysis.

items.name: dataset-explore
items.title: Dataset Exploration
items.description: Use when inspecting structure, shapes, types and units in HDF5, BP5, Parquet or compressed files. Triggers on "what is in this file", "open this dataset", "inspect this HDF5". Not for large-data reductions; use large-data-read.
items.summary: Inspect the structure, shapes, types and units of HDF5, BP5, Parquet and compressed files.

items.name: dataset-report
items.title: Dataset Report
items.description: Use when creating a report from a small numeric HDF5 dataset with a CSV, statistics and figure. Triggers on "dataset report", "inspect summarize and plot". Not for large-file streaming or model fitting.
items.summary: Turn a small numeric HDF5 dataset into a report with a CSV, statistics and a figure.

items.name: dataset-stage
items.title: Dataset Staging
items.description: Use when finding dataset metadata and downloading a supported resource to a verified local path. Triggers on "find a dataset", "download this data", "stage this resource". Not for literature surveys; use research-survey.
items.summary: Find dataset metadata and download a supported resource to a verified local path.

items.name: geospatial-map
items.title: Geospatial Mapping
items.description: Use when validating GeoJSON, querying spatial relationships, mapping features or analyzing terrain grids. Triggers on "GeoJSON", "render a map", "DEM", "point cloud". Not for CRS interpretation alone; use coordinate-systems.
items.summary: Validate GeoJSON, query spatial relationships, map features and analyze terrain grids.

items.name: gpu-vector
items.title: Programming the gpu_vector paged vector
items.description: Use when writing, porting, optimizing or debugging GPU kernels over CLIO's paged out-of-core vector (gv::Vector / gv::DeviceVector): layout, page and cache sizing, fetch/hold/flush placement, eviction safety, multi-node generations, tier policy. Triggers on "gpu_vector", "gv::Vector", "DeviceVector", "CoFetch", "HoldPage", "out-of-core kernel", "CLIO_COROC_RUN", "ReorganizeHint". Not for writing a runtime module; use chimod-dev. Not for wiring tiers into a deployment; use storage-compose.
items.summary: Write and tune GPU kernels over CLIO's paged out-of-core vector, validated resident and out of core.

items.name: io-performance
items.title: I/O Performance
items.description: Use when interpreting bandwidth, IOPS, request sizes and MPI-IO counters already provided. Triggers on "is 40 MB/s bad", "small writes", "collective versus independent". Calls no tools. Not for loading a profile; use job-diagnose.
items.summary: Interpret bandwidth, IOPS, request sizes and MPI-IO counters from existing measurements.

items.name: job-diagnose
items.title: Job Diagnosis
items.description: Use when investigating I/O bottlenecks using a genuine Darshan profile and application logs. Triggers on "Darshan log", "why was this job slow", "I/O bottleneck". Not for metric interpretation alone; use io-performance.
items.summary: Investigate I/O bottlenecks from a real Darshan profile and the application's logs.

items.name: large-data-read
items.title: Dataset Reading
items.description: Use when choosing bounded reads and distinguishing sampled summaries from exact large-data statistics. Triggers on "file is huge", "compute this mean", "out of memory". Not for initial format discovery; use dataset-explore.
items.summary: Plan bounded reads of large data and tell sampled summaries apart from exact statistics.

items.name: log-search
items.title: Log Search
items.description: Use when narrowing large application logs by timestamp, level, keyword or error pattern. Triggers on "find the error", "search this log", "what happened at". Not for Darshan profiles; use job-diagnose.
items.summary: Narrow large application logs by timestamp, level, keyword or error pattern.

items.name: research-survey
items.title: Research Survey
items.description: Use when searching prior work and identifying datasets associated with research claims. Triggers on "find papers on", "literature survey", "prior work". Not for formatting a known citation list; use bibliography.
items.summary: Search prior work and find the datasets behind research claims.

items.name: results-summary
items.title: Results Summary
items.description: Use when calculating tabular summaries and plotting transformed CSV or Excel data. Triggers on "summarize this table", "plot these results", "grouped mean". Not for mesh or volume rendering; use simulation-visualize.
items.summary: Calculate tabular summaries and plot transformed CSV or Excel data.

items.name: seismic-analysis
items.title: Seismic Analysis
items.description: Use when inspecting SAC waveforms or evaluating a saved earthquake event catalogue. Triggers on "SAC", "waveform statistics", "b-value", "magnitude completeness". Not for geospatial mapping; use geospatial-map.
items.summary: Inspect SAC waveforms and evaluate a saved earthquake event catalogue.

items.name: session-record
items.title: Session Provenance
items.description: Use when explicitly recording or retrieving a research decision trail with ChronoLog. Triggers on "record this session", "ChronoLog", "retrieve our decisions". Not for job execution profiling; use job-diagnose.
items.summary: Record or retrieve a research decision trail with ChronoLog.

items.name: simulation-visualize
items.title: Simulation Visualization
items.description: Use when inspecting and rendering simulation fields with ParaView. Triggers on "isosurface", "slice this volume", "render the field". Not for tabular charts; use results-summary.
items.summary: Open, measure and render simulation fields in a live ParaView view.

items.name: slicing
items.title: Slicing for 3D printing
items.description: Use when a 3D model (STL, 3MF, STEP, OBJ) is to be sliced for a 3D printer, or the person asks how long a print takes, how much filament it uses, whether it needs supports, or to see its layers. Triggers on "slice this for my printer", "how long will it take to print", "show me the layers", "does it need supports". Not for slicing a simulation volume; use simulation-visualize.
items.summary: Slice a 3D model with the slicer you have, then check its layers, print time and filament before printing.

items.name: slurm-script
items.title: Slurm Scripts
items.description: Use when preparing Slurm resource requests, arrays and dependencies or diagnosing pending jobs. Triggers on "sbatch", "job array", "why is my job pending". Not for JARVIS execution; use cluster-run.
items.summary: Prepare Slurm resource requests, job arrays and dependencies, and diagnose pending jobs.

items.name: software-environment
items.title: Software Environments
items.description: Use when checking installed Spack packages and available or saved module environments. Triggers on "module avail", "which MPI", "is this installed". Not for executing a workload; use cluster-run.
items.summary: Check installed Spack packages and available or saved module environments.

items.name: storage-compose
items.title: Composing a storage system from CLIO Core modules
items.description: Use when designing, configuring or reviewing a CLIO Core storage deployment: choosing which shipped modules to compose (bdev, safe_bdev, CTE cores, write-back/write-thru caches, replication, shm cache, indexer, compressor, stream, filesystem, CAE), ordering the chain, and stating its consistency and fault tolerance. Triggers on "compose section", "clio_default.yaml", "next_pool_id", "replication_factor", "is this durable", "what survives a crash". Not for writing a new module; use chimod-dev.
items.summary: Compose CLIO Core's shipped modules into a storage system and state what it guarantees.

items.name: storage-format
items.title: Storage Formats
items.description: Use when selecting scientific file formats, chunk layouts or compression for an access pattern. Triggers on "HDF5 versus Parquet", "chunk size", "should I compress". Calls no tools. Not for interpreting profiler counters; use io-performance.
items.summary: Choose scientific file formats, chunk layouts and compression for an access pattern.

items.name: clio-analysis
items.title: From results to insight
items.description: Turn a dataset into summary statistics, a figure, and a live 3D view.
items.outcome: Summary statistics, clear figures and guidance for interpreting them.
items.summary: Turn a dataset into summary statistics, a figure, and a live 3D view.

items.name: clio-chemistry
items.title: Chemistry
items.description: Find a compound, build and change its structure, compute energies and spectra, and simulate adsorption.
items.outcome: Find a compound, build and change its structure, compute energies and spectra, and simulate adsorption.
items.summary: Find a compound, build and change its structure, compute energies and spectra, and simulate adsorption.

items.name: clio-dataset-report
items.title: Dataset Report
items.description: Turn a small HDF5 dataset into a report with a CSV, figure, checked statistics and evidence review.
items.summary: Turn a small HDF5 dataset into a report with a CSV, figure, checked statistics and evidence review.

items.name: clio-electronics
items.title: Simulate a circuit
items.description: Simulate a circuit with the SPICE simulator you have and plot its waveforms.
items.outcome: Run a circuit with the SPICE simulator you have and plot its waveforms.
items.summary: Simulate a circuit with the SPICE simulator you have and plot its waveforms.

items.name: clio-fabrication
items.title: Make a part
items.description: Slice a 3D model for a printer and check it layer by layer before printing.
items.outcome: Slice a model with the slicer you have and check every layer before printing.
items.summary: Slice a 3D model for a printer and check it layer by layer before printing.

items.name: clio-geoscience
items.title: Explore the physical world
items.description: Maps, terrain, geoprocessing, waveforms, ocean, weather, grids, NASA Earth data.
items.outcome: Workflows for geographic features, terrain, seismic and NASA Earth-science data, on a 3D globe.
items.summary: Maps, terrain, geoprocessing, waveforms, ocean, weather, grids, NASA Earth data.

items.name: clio-home
items.title: Work with your home
items.description: Read your home's sensors and their history, control devices, and write automations.
items.outcome: Read your Home Assistant's sensors and history, control devices and write automations.
items.summary: Read your home's sensors and their history, control devices, and write automations.

items.name: clio-hpc
items.title: Run work on a cluster
items.description: Install a code, wrap it in a pipeline, submit it, and follow it on a cluster.
items.outcome: A resource-aware path from software setup to workload monitoring.
items.summary: Install a code, wrap it in a pipeline, submit it, and follow it on a cluster.

items.name: clio-performance
items.title: Understand a slow job
items.description: Work out why a finished job was slower than it should have been.
items.outcome: An investigation of I/O behavior, logs and potential bottlenecks.
items.summary: Work out why a finished job was slower than it should have been.

items.name: clio-research
items.title: Find the research behind it
items.description: Find papers on a topic, read them in a PDF viewer, and find the datasets behind them.
items.outcome: Papers to find and read, and datasets, with guidance for discovery and staging.
items.summary: Find papers on a topic, read them in a PDF viewer, and find the datasets behind them.

items.name: clio-scientific-io
items.title: Explore a scientific dataset
items.description: Open a scientific data file, see its structure, and read part of it.
items.outcome: A bounded view of your data, its structure and storage choices.
items.summary: Open a scientific data file, see its structure, and read part of it.
